title: Pixel 2 compatibility issues?
body:
I just got a pixel 2 and the version of xdrip+ I downloaded a few months ago (xDrip-plus-20171006-1a08760.apk) works fine.

But after it upgrades itself it stops collecting data and if I restart the sensor like I did this morning, it gets stuck on the collecting initial readings pop up.

I'm going to remove it and install the old version again to see if it start working again...

Information:

Phone: Google Pixel 2
Android: 8.0.0 Security patch Nov 5, 2017
Build: OPD1.170816.025

Working version: xDrip-plus-20171006-1a08760.apk
Failing version: xDrip-plus-20171113-20a4313.apk

Using Dexcom G5

Latest version worked on my Nexus 6P...

How can I help debug this?

comments.body:
When you got stuck on the collecting initial readings what status information did it show? No readings at all or getting up to 2 etc?

Jon

I am using moto g4 and with wxBridge Wixel
After I click at start sensor and chosse the date of start...
stay at this screen
![img_4978](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/810062/33871743-f67f78d0-defa-11e7-91cf-de0fd9c69a2a.jpg)
On mine, I believe it had all three circles filled in.

Can you try the latest nightly to see if that resolves the issue:

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/How-to-get-the-Nightlies-on-Automatic-Update
On my Pixel 2 it also gets stuck on the collecting initial readings with no readings at all. I have just sent the logs, and hope this helps.
It's working now. The problem was that my Dexcom was still paired to my old my phone.
Marking as resolved, please re-open if issues persist.
